title: US Tariff Data: HTS, additional duties by country and EU import duties
description:
Clean, machine-readable copies of the US Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS), the chapter 99 additional duties that name a country (Section 301, 232, 338, the forced-labor duty and the ended IEEPA and Section 122 measures), and EU import duties by country of origin, as flat CSV and JSON with a Frictionless datapackage.json descriptor. Regenerated after each HTS revision.

Browse every code, rate and country at checkdutyrates.com.

US data: public domain (17 U.S.C. 105), compilation released under CC0 1.0. EU data: Open Government Licence v3.0 (contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0).
